news.thesis: WUNC Nov 10 7:18pm ET: after provisional counts Smith (D) now leads incumbent Murphy (R) by 264 votes (~0.1% of ~240k) in NC-3 with Greene provisionals and military ballots (due Nov 12) still out; well inside the 1% recount threshold and recount requests are due noon Nov 17 with county canvass Nov 13; AP does not call races this close while a recount is available and Murphy (who declared victory Nov 4) is now trailing so likely to request one; my P(no call before Nov 18) 0.93 v market NO ~0.78-0.81 (YES 0.19/0.22); thin uncategorized market not repriced for the flip to a sub-300 margin

Newsweek Nov 9 17:45 UTC: race uncalled with Colom up ~2;500 (0.28%); Hyde-Smith camp says she is 'not backing down' and will 'see this through to the very end'; her lawyers demanded affidavit ballots be segregated and state GOP readying legal options; Trump today (CNBC 18:02 UTC) questioned midterm results; counties certify Nov 13 so any concession likely comes after certification or a court fight not before Nov 14; my P(concede before Nov 14) 0.25 v market 0.34 bid/0.40 ask; thin market (vol ~580) pricing a quick concession once AP calls

AP 5pm Fri Nov 6 and WLBT Nov 7: Colom leads Hyde-Smith by 2;574 votes (~0.27%) with thousands of affidavit ballots still uncounted; affidavit ID-cure and mail-arrival deadline is Nov 10 and Rankin County (GOP-leaning) only starts scanning affidavits at 5pm Nov 10 so a big block stays out until the night of the deadline; race uncalled and GOP vowing to fight; my P(no AP call before 12am ET Nov 11) 0.55 v market NO ~0.40 (YES 0.58/0.61); thin market (vol ~1.3k) leaning on Colom's growing lead rather than the counting calendar

Truth Social post Nov 7 ~19:00 UTC (Fox/Yahoo/CNBC): Trump wrote 'I am pleased to announce' Dana White 'has been offered the job of Press Secretary'; a public Trump announcement naming a pick plausibly settles YES and White accepting or another name by Nov 13 adds odds; my P(yes) 0.40 v market 0.15 bid/0.19 ask in 18:22 UTC catalog; thin market (vol ~300) priced before the post; rules unverified on whether an offer counts so P discounted

WTVA/CBS Nov 6: Colom leads Hyde-Smith by ~1;900 votes (about 0.2%) with 12;000-20;000 affidavit ballots plus ~3;600 absentees uncounted; counties have until Nov 13 to certify; NRSC demanding affidavit ballots be segregated and both camps preparing to litigate; a 0.2% margin with contested ballots and certification landing one day before the deadline makes an AP call before Nov 14 far from certain; my P(no call) 0.30 v market NO ~0.10-0.15; thin market anchored on a quick call

Eagles injury report Nov 5 17:45 ET: benched QB McKee downgraded to limited with rib injury while starter Milton is not listed; RotoWire says he may miss the game with rookie Payton backing up; my P(yes) 0.06 v market 0.28 bid/0.32 ask; thin prop still priced near a backup with real playing time and the Eagles are auditioning QBs so a quick return to McKee is unlikely

PULSE: Thu Nov 5 close S&P -4.35% Nasdaq -5.52% Nasdaq 100 -6.36% worst day since 2020 with VIX highest since March; CNN index was already headlined Extreme Fear earlier this week per Benzinga; one rebound session unlikely to lift it out by Nov 6; my P(yes) 0.80 v ask 0.49; live reading and market rules not verified so P is discounted

AP Nov 4 22:30 UTC: Eagles benched Tanner McKee and named Joe Milton starter v Giants; McKee throws a TD only if Milton is pulled or hurt; my P(yes) 0.09 v market 0.29 bid/0.33 ask; thin second-order prop still priced near a starter's odds

AP Nov 4 22:30 UTC: Eagles benched Tanner McKee and named Joe Milton starter v Giants; 175+ yards needs McKee to play most of a half or more; my P(yes) 0.05 v market 0.22 bid/0.25 ask; thin second-order prop has not repriced for the QB change
